main.remarks: This is the foundation of all storage items.

field.name: ContentStreamed
field.summary: True if the Object's data is streamed. Use GetContentStream instead of GetContent.

field.name: DataEncryptInfo
field.summary: Legacy encryption metadata retained only for compatibility with older in-memory and serialized flows.

field.name: DataType
field.remarks: The format of the item Content.

field.name: CachedHashCode
field.summary: Cached `GetHashCode()` value for the current in-memory item state.

field.name: FieldIntegrityHashes
field.summary: Persisted field integrity hashes for hash-only integrity scenarios.
field.remarks: Stores current fallback integrity baselines for fields that do not currently rely on an active field assertion.

field.name: HashCodeCached
field.summary: True when reflects the current in-memory item state.

field.name: FieldAssertions
field.summary: Persisted serialized field assertions keyed by field name.
field.remarks: Stores the active current-state `DataFieldAssertion` payload for asserted fields.

field.name: SyncLockCount
field.summary: Global counter used to issue synchronization lock order tokens.

field.name: SyncLockOrder
field.summary: Immutable per-instance token used for cross-object synchronization lock order.

method.name: CheckDataHashCore
method.summary: Core hash verification logic for data integrity.
method.returns: True if the current data matches the stored hash for the current state.

method.name: ClearHashCodeCache_NoSync
method.summary: Invalidate the current cached `GetHashCode()` value without acquiring additional synchronization locks.

method.name: BuildCanonicalEnvelopeRootContext
method.summary: Build the canonical caller-derived root-context bytes used to bind `DataItem` envelope operations.
method.param: Protected field-state classification to bind into the canonical root context.
method.returns: Canonical root-context bytes, or null when the current `DataItem` identity is unavailable.

method.name: GetCachedHashCode_NoSync
method.summary: Return the current cached `GetHashCode()` value, computing and caching it when needed.
method.returns: The current cached hash code value.

method.name: GetCachedHashCode_NoSyncAsync
method.summary: Return the current cached `GetHashCode()` value asynchronously, computing and caching it when needed.
method.returns: The current cached hash code value.

method.name: GetAuthorizationCertificate
method.summary: Serialize the local authorization certificate from the supplied security context.
method.param: The security context providing the local certificate.
method.returns: The serialized authorization certificate, or null when no local certificate is available.

method.name: ModifiedNow
method.summary: Update the modified timestamp and invalidate the current cached `GetHashCode()` value.
method.returns: True when the modified timestamp update succeeds.

method.name: CheckManager
method.summary: Check whether the supplied security context satisfies the current manager authorization requirements.
method.param: The security context providing the local certificate for authorization checks.
method.returns: True if the supplied security context authorizes the operation.

method.name: CheckDataHashCoreUtf16
method.summary: Core hash verification logic for data integrity.
method.returns: True if the current data matches the stored hash for the current state.

method.name: Clone
method.summary: Clone Item.
method.returns: Cloned Item.

method.name: CloneOpen
method.summary: Clone Item.
method.returns: Cloned Item.

method.name: Clone_NoSync
method.summary: Clone Item without acquiring synchronization locks.
method.returns: Cloned Item.

method.name: DecryptDataBuffer
method.summary: Decrypt a Data Buffer.
method.param: The security context to use for decryption.
method.returns: Decrypted Data.

method.name: DecryptDataBufferAsync
method.summary: Decrypt a Data Buffer.
method.param: The security context to use for decryption.
method.returns: Decrypted Data.

method.name: DecryptDataBufferWithHash
method.summary: Decrypt an in-memory payload and return both plaintext bytes and the computed plaintext hash.
method.param: The security context to use for decryption.
method.returns: Decryption result containing plaintext bytes and the computed plaintext hash.

method.name: ApplyAssertionState
method.summary: Apply the current assertion policy for a field after its secure hash has been updated.
method.param: Field key whose active assertion state is being updated.
Current security context controlling whether active assertions are required.
method.returns: True when the active assertion state is valid for the field; otherwise false.

method.name: BuildProtectionInfo
method.summary: Create current-state `DataProtectionInfo` summary metadata for the active protected representation.
method.param: Security context used to populate issuer, recipient, and purpose summary metadata.
method.returns: Current-state protection summary metadata.

method.name: ClearAssertion
method.summary: Remove the active assertion entry for a field from the current-state assertion store.
method.param: Field key whose active assertion should be removed.

method.name: GetProtectionAssertions
method.summary: Project the current-state assertion store into `DataProtectionAssertionSummary` values.
method.returns: Current-state assertion summaries.

method.name: GetProtectionRecipients
method.summary: Project the current security context recipient set into `DataProtectionRecipientSummary` values.
method.param: Security context used to resolve current protection recipients.
method.returns: Current protection recipient summaries.

method.name: ValidateDataCore
method.summary: Validate the active current-state field for this item.
method.remarks: Base behavior validates `EncryptedData` when the item is protected, otherwise it validates clear `Content`.
method.param: Composite security context used to resolve signer identity and validate the active field state.
method.returns: True when the current active field state validates successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: CreateBuffer
method.summary: Create an in-memory buffer sized for the current operation when a positive capacity is known.
method.param: The initial buffer capacity. Values less than or equal to zero use the default memory stream growth behavior.
method.returns: A writable in-memory buffer.

method.name: HashDataChunked
method.summary: Hash an in-memory byte sequence.
method.param: The in-memory byte sequence to hash.
method.returns: The SHA-512 digest for the supplied byte sequence.

method.name: WriteGuidBytes
method.summary: Write Guid content into a caller-owned byte buffer.

method.name: HashGuid
method.summary: Hash Guid content without allocating a Guid byte array.
method.returns: The SHA-512 digest for the supplied Guid.

method.name: HashGuidSpan
method.summary: Hash Guid content directly into a caller-provided SHA-512 destination buffer.
method.param: Destination buffer that receives the 64-byte SHA-512 digest.

method.name: ReadHashPrefixInt32
method.summary: Read the first four bytes of a hash as an value without allocating.
method.param: Hash bytes whose leading four bytes are interpreted as an integer.
method.returns: The integer represented by the first four bytes of the supplied hash.

method.name: AppendHashedInt32
method.summary: Hash a 32-bit value into a fixed-size digest and append that digest to an existing incremental hash.
method.param: The incremental hash that receives the hashed integer digest.
The 32-bit value to hash and append.

method.name: DecryptToStream
method.summary: Decrypt an in-memory encrypted payload directly into a caller-owned destination stream.
method.param: Destination stream that receives the decrypted payload.
The security context to use for decryption.
method.returns: True when decryption succeeds and the destination contains the decrypted payload.

method.name: DecryptToStreamStream
method.summary: Decrypt a readable source stream directly into a caller-owned destination stream.
method.param: Readable encrypted source stream to decrypt.
Destination stream that receives the decrypted payload.
The security context to use for decryption.
method.returns: True when decryption succeeds and the destination contains the decrypted payload.

method.name: DecryptFileToHash
method.summary: Decrypt a streamed content file in place while computing the SHA-512 digest of the transformed destination bytes during the write pass.
method.param: FILE path backing the streamed content.
The security context to use for decryption.
method.returns: The SHA-512 digest of the decrypted file when the in-place replacement succeeds.

method.name: Deserialize
method.summary: Deserialize Object.
method.returns: Output Object.

method.name: DeserializeMemoryStream
method.summary: Deserialize an item directly from an in-memory stream buffer.
method.param: In-memory stream containing the serialized object payload.
method.returns: Output Object.

method.name: DeserializeAny
method.summary: Deserialize Object.
method.returns: Output Object.

method.name: EncryptDataBuffer
method.summary: Encrypt a Data Buffer.
method.param: The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: Encrypted Data.

method.name: TryResolveRecipient
method.summary: Resolve a recipient descriptor into a concrete recipient certificate record.
method.param: Known objects keyed by object identifier.
Optional identity directory used when the recipient is not already fully materialized.
Receives the resolved recipient when resolution succeeds.
method.returns: True if the recipient could be resolved to a usable certificate record.

method.name: ResolveRecipients
method.summary: Resolve the current security context recipient set into concrete recipient certificate records.
method.param: The security context providing known objects, explicit recipients, and directory access.
method.returns: The resolved recipient set, or null when resolution fails.

method.name: EncryptToStream
method.summary: Encrypt a readable source stream directly into a caller-owned destination stream.
method.param: Destination stream that receives the encrypted payload.
The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: True when encryption succeeds and the destination contains the encrypted payload.

method.name: EncryptFileToHash
method.summary: Encrypt a streamed content file in place while computing the SHA-512 digest of the transformed destination bytes during the write pass.
method.param: FILE path backing the streamed content.
The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: The SHA-512 digest of the encrypted file when the in-place replacement succeeds.

method.name: EncryptDataBufferAsync
method.summary: Encrypt an in-memory payload using a pre-sized destination buffer when the envelope size can be estimated.
method.param: The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: Encrypted Data.

method.name: EncryptDataBufferWithHash
method.summary: Encrypt an in-memory payload and return both ciphertext bytes and the computed plaintext hash.
method.param: The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: Encryption result containing ciphertext bytes and the computed plaintext hash.

method.name: EncryptDataBufferUtf16Async
method.summary: Encrypt UTF-16 text using a pre-sized destination buffer when the envelope size can be estimated.
method.param: The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: Encrypted Data.

method.name: EncryptDataBufferUtf16
method.summary: Encrypt UTF-16 text without first materializing a plaintext byte array.
method.param: The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: Encrypted Data.

method.name: EncryptDataBufferUtf16WithHash
method.summary: Encrypt UTF-16 text and return both ciphertext bytes and the computed plaintext hash.
method.param: The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: Encryption result containing ciphertext bytes and the computed plaintext hash.

method.name: GetUtf16StringMemoryStream
method.summary: Decode UTF-16 text directly from an in-memory stream buffer.
method.param: The in-memory stream containing UTF-16 encoded bytes.
method.returns: Decoded UTF-16 text.

method.name: GetMemoryStreamBuffer
method.summary: Return the exact byte content of an in-memory stream, reusing the underlying array when it already matches the logical length.
method.param: The in-memory stream containing binary content.
method.returns: The exact underlying buffer when it matches the logical stream length; otherwise a copied array.

method.name: FromFile

method.returns: Object created from file.

method.name: GetContentStream_NoSync
method.summary: Opens a Stream from the FILE path without synchronization. The Object's Content field is ignored.
method.returns: Content Stream.

method.name: OpenSequentialRead
method.summary: Open a readable file stream configured for sequential access.
method.returns: Readable file stream configured for sequential access.

method.name: OpenExclusiveWrite
method.summary: Open a writable file stream with exclusive access and async-capable file options.
method.returns: Writable file stream with exclusive access.

method.name: ResolveRecipient
method.summary: Resolve a data protection recipient using embedded material, known objects, or the configured identity directory.
method.param: Known security objects available on the current context.
Optional identity directory used to resolve recipient identities.
method.returns: Resolved recipient including certificate material, or null when the recipient cannot be resolved.

method.summary: Resolve the effective recipient set for a security operation, including the self recipient when configured.
method.param: Security context supplying known objects, recipients, and optional directory.
method.returns: Resolved recipient set, or null when the effective recipient set cannot be resolved.

method.name: UpdateFieldIntegrityHash
method.summary: Update a field integrity hash entry.
method.param: True to store data value directly.
method.returns: True if Data hash computed and stored successfully.

method.name: UpdateFieldIntegrityHashAsync
method.summary: Update a field integrity hash entry asynchronously.
method.param: True to store data value directly.
method.returns: True if Data hash computed and stored successfully.

method.name: UpdateFieldIntegrityHashUtf16
method.summary: Update a field integrity hash entry from UTF-16 text.
method.returns: True if Data hash computed and stored successfully.

method.name: UpdateFieldIntegrityHashUtf16Async
method.summary: Update a field integrity hash entry from UTF-16 text asynchronously.
method.returns: True if Data hash computed and stored successfully.

method.name: UpdateFieldIntegrityHashAsyncStream
method.summary: Update a field integrity hash entry from a readable stream asynchronously.
method.returns: True if Data hash computed and stored successfully.

method.name: UpdateFieldAssertion
method.summary: Create or replace the active field assertion for the given field key.
method.param: The key for the hash/signature (e.g., field name, `DataSecurityHCKey`, or `DataSecurityMDKey`).
The security context containing the local certificate and assertion metadata.
method.returns: True if the active field assertion was computed and stored successfully.

method.name: VerifyDataCoreHashed
method.summary: Verify a field assertion against a caller-supplied current field hash.
method.param: The security context used to resolve the assertion certificate.
The current precomputed hash for the field value.
method.returns: True if the field assertion is valid and matches the supplied field hash.

method.name: VerifyDataFieldCore
method.summary: Core current-state field assertion verification routine shared by byte, stream, UTF-16, pre-hashed, hash-code, and metadata-integrity verification paths.
method.param: The security context used to resolve the assertion certificate.
The current in-memory field bytes when verification is being performed from a byte buffer.
The current field stream when verification is being performed from a stream.
The current precomputed field hash when verification is being performed from a hash value.
method.returns: True if the active field assertion is valid and matches the supplied current field representation, the computed hash-code integrity representation, or the canonical metadata integrity representation.

method.name: VerifyDataCore
method.summary: Verifies the most recent digital signature for the specified field using the provided current field data or stream.
method.param: The name of the field to verify (e.g., "Content").
The security context used to resolve the assertion certificate.
The current in-memory data for the field.
The current stream for the field.
method.returns: True if the signature is valid and the current data matches the signed hash; otherwise, false.

method.name: VerifyDataCoreUtf16
method.summary: Verify a field assertion against current UTF-16 text data.
method.param: The security context used to resolve the assertion certificate.
method.returns: True if the field assertion is valid and matches the supplied UTF-16 field data.

method.name: ComputeUtf16HashAsync
method.summary: Compute a SHA-512 hash for UTF-16 text using the same chunking policy as the current field-integrity-hash helpers.
method.returns: Computed SHA-512 hash.

method.name: GetAssertionFieldState
method.summary: Map a field key to its assertion field-state classification.
method.returns: Assertion field-state classification for the supplied field key.

method.name: ResolveAssertionCertificate
method.summary: Resolve the certificate required to verify an active field assertion.
method.param: The security context providing the local object, known objects, and optional directory.
Assertion metadata describing the expected issuer identity and thumbprint.
method.returns: Resolved verification certificate, or null when no matching certificate can be found.

method.name: VerifyFieldIntegrityHash
method.summary: Verify a field integrity hash against the current data buffer.
method.returns: True if the stored field integrity hash matches the current data.

method.name: VerifyFieldIntegrityHashStream
method.summary: Verify a field integrity hash against the current stream data.
method.returns: True if secure hash match current data.

method.name: VerifyFieldIntegrityHashUtf16
method.summary: Verify a field integrity hash against UTF-16 text data.
method.param: UTF-16 text to hash and verify.
method.returns: True if the stored field integrity hash matches the current UTF-16 text data.

method.name: VerifySecureSignature
method.summary: Verify the signature for the given key using the provided ManagementKey.
method.param: The key for the hash/signature (e.g., field name).
The ManagementKey containing the certificate for verification.
method.returns: True if the signature is valid for the hash and key.

method.name: WipeDataCore
method.summary: The core recursive implementation for WipeData.
method.param: The security context used for authorization.
A set of already visited objects.
method.returns: True if the object has already been processed; otherwise, false.

method.name: WipeDataInMemoryOnly
method.summary: Wipe only in-memory data for this object and any referenced objects.
method.param: The security context used for authorization.
A flag indicating whether locks must be acquired.
method.returns: True if the wipe operation completed successfully; otherwise, false.

method.name: WipeDataInMemoryOnlyCore
method.summary: The core recursive implementation for wiping only the in-memory data.
method.param: The security context used for authorization.
A set of already visited objects.
A flag indicating whether locks must be acquired.
method.returns: True if the object has already been processed; otherwise, false.

method.name: AcquireLocks
method.summary: Acquire the metadata and data synchronization locks using the configured timeout.
method.remarks: Acquires Sync.Meta first and then Sync.Data. If the data lock cannot be acquired, the metadata lock is released before throwing SyncException.

method.name: AcquireLocksAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously acquire the metadata and data synchronization locks using the configured timeout.
method.remarks: Acquires Sync.Meta first and then Sync.Data. If the data lock cannot be acquired, the metadata lock is released before throwing SyncException.
method.returns: A task that completes when both locks have been acquired.

method.name: ReleaseLocks
method.summary: Release the data and metadata synchronization locks acquired by the lock helpers.

method.name: TryAcquireMetaLocks
method.summary: Acquire dual-object metadata synchronization locks without touching data locks.
method.param: The other item participating in the metadata comparison.
Receives the acquired synchronization lock state when successful.
method.remarks: Orders objects by the immutable synchronization lock token, then acquires Sync.Meta on each object. Returns false after releasing any partial acquisitions when the full metadata lock set cannot be obtained.
method.returns: True if both objects were locked successfully for direct metadata field comparison.

method.name: TryAcquireSyncLocks
method.summary: Acquire dual-object synchronization locks without using public getters or clone paths.
method.param: The other item participating in the comparison.
Receives the acquired synchronization lock state when successful.
method.remarks: Orders objects by the immutable synchronization lock token, then acquires Sync.Meta followed by Sync.Data on each object. Returns false after releasing any partial acquisitions when the full lock set cannot be obtained.
method.returns: True if both objects were locked successfully for direct field comparison.

method.name: GetSyncLockOrder
method.summary: Get the immutable synchronization lock order token for this instance.
method.returns: The per-instance canonical synchronization lock order token.

method.name: ReleaseSyncLocks
method.summary: Release synchronization locks recorded by TryAcquireSyncLocks.
method.param: The acquired synchronization lock state to release.
method.remarks: Releases locks in strict reverse order of acquisition.
